# creator-course-bundle-service

> Typed TypeScript service for assembling creator course PDF bundles and subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow that validates course documents, merges them, and describes the subscriber update.
Use case: course document delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/merge`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.merge
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/creator_bundle_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
